response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished staff-level software engineer with 10+ years of production experience and proven technical leadership credentials. However, the position explicitly requires 8+ years building production-grade AI systems, and his background is primarily in general software engineering. While his current role at re:cinq involves MCP code generators and agentic workflow infrastructure since April 2025, this represents recent entry into AI-adjacent work rather than the deep AI expertise in vector databases, RAG, and LLM optimization essential for leading customer-facing deployments at the staff level.
strengths: Proven staff-level technical leadership with 10+ years shipping complex systems and mentoring engineers across multiple companies
Strong TypeScript/Node.js production engineering with experience building high-scale systems and microservices architectures
Currently engaged with MCP code generators and agentic workflow frameworks at re:cinq, demonstrating active pivot into GenAI infrastructure
concerns: No evidence of 8+ years building production AI/ML systems; GenAI expertise limited to infrastructure tooling work since April 2025
Missing critical GenAI expertise: vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM optimization, and multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph or CrewAI
No Python experience despite explicit requirement; Master's/PhD in AI/CS preferred but not held (has Bachelor's in CS only)

key_factors.factor: Lacks required 8+ years production AI systems experience
Strong staff-level technical leadership and engineering foundation
Missing core GenAI technology stack (Python, RAG, vector databases, LLMs)
